purpose: Execute a leakage-controlled, study-held-out, nested and cluster-aware sequence-rank analysis on three public source anchors using a target universe frozen before the T192 sources entered the project.

estimand.primary: For each held-out laboratory anchor, the macro-average measurement-batch Spearman correlation between source-local descending positive-quantification rank and predictions from a sequence ridge model trained only on the other laboratory anchors.
secondary: macro-average held-out batch MAE and RMSE
paired full-sequence minus amino-acid-composition-only Spearman difference
within-development-batch rank-permutation null for the full model
held-out source and held-out batch effective sample accounting
estimand.unit_of_analysis: measurement batch; source-specific biological-unit semantics are retained and not promoted to donor independence

prefrozen_target_universe.target_definition: All canonical accessions marked common_rank_target_member=true in the R3 common-target ledger, which was frozen before the T192 source packages were admitted.
prefrozen_target_universe.availability_rule: A pre-frozen accession contributes an observation only when the source map marks it rank_target_eligible=true with a finite strictly positive author value; missing, blank and zero states remain missing and are never imputed.

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on sequence length, estimated molecular mass, hydrophobicity, aromaticity, acidic/basic/cysteine/proline fractions, mean Kyte-Doolittle and amino-acid fractions
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on amino-acid fractions only
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

ambiguity_policy.source_map_coordinate: retain every row-level canonical mapping from the audited source map and expose source_identifier unchanged
ambiguity_policy.multi_accession_groups: retain as traceable sensitivity observations with an ambiguity flag; do not describe them as unambiguous protein measurements
ambiguity_policy.technical_replicates: retain source coordinates, but do not treat technical replicates as independent biological units
ambiguity_policy.pooled_source: Dalian pooled/unspecified plasma is descriptive at source/batch level and supplies no donor-level uncertainty

uncertainty.cluster: held-out measurement batch; no donor independence is inferred where donor IDs are unavailable
uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: report the interval and cluster count; do not convert a three-anchor analysis into a biological n claim

negative_control.alpha_policy: hold the observed nested-selected full-model alpha fixed within each outer fold

claim_boundary: This execution is an exploratory, leakage-controlled cross-source portability analysis on public paper-linked data. It does not establish independent biological validation, evaluator lockbox performance, no-author scientific reproduction, causal material claims, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
